hypothesis: The teacher target values a position opened at the next open and liquidated at the 21st open (N = 20) with no intervening trades, but the realized policy re-decides every close, so realized holding periods (median 4 sessions in M2/M3) never match the horizon the predictions were trained for. Test: make the decision cadence equal to the horizon while keeping predictions, costs and ledger frozen.
single_changed_axis: decision cadence only: daily re-decision -> decisions at the fixed 20-session grid i_k = 3031 + 20k (k = 0..145), identical to the predict-h20 grid; everything else (stored M2 predictions p, cost band half_cost, integer ledger, deposits, period) unchanged

formula.decision_sessions: i_k = 3031 + 20k for k = 0..145 (2014-12-30 .. 2026-10-28); the stored M2 prediction exists for every i_k
formula.values: half_cost_k = d(C_raw[i_k]) / 2, v0 = p_{i_k} - half_cost_k, v1 = p_{i_k} + half_cost_k; score = v1 if actual qty > 0 at close i_k else v0
formula.action: score > 0 -> weight 1 from open i_k + 1 until the next grid execution open i_k + 21; score < 0 -> weight 0 over the same span; exactly 0 -> keep the current state; no decisions at off-grid closes
formula.endpoint_consistency: a block decided at close i_k is held (or kept flat) until open i_k + 21, which is exactly the teacher's liquidation endpoint Q = O[i_k + 21]; the next decision at close i_k + 20 then re-evaluates with p_{i_k + 20}
formula.cash_between_grid_opens: daily deposits accumulate as idle cash and are deployed only at grid executions (both variants identically); no maintenance buys between grid points
formula.last_block: the pending block (decision 2026-10-28, execution 2026-10-29) executes normally and is marked to the cutoff; no decision after 2026-10-28

information_timing: at close i_k: stored p_{i_k} (frozen M2, state independent), raw close C_raw[i_k], actual M4 held state; execution at open i_k + 1 after observing O; no future open, no outcome, no label

variants.R1g_grid_cadence_always_long: weight 1 at every grid close with the same idle-cash mechanics (identical to allocate-h20 variant A semantics); needed because idle cash between grid opens confounds a comparison with the daily R1
variants.anchors_loaded: M2 daily (d9556ca9), M3 (3046a590), R1 daily and M1 (78176801) for descriptive comparison only

comparisons.primary: M4 minus R1g terminal post-cost PnL, continuous annual increments, drawdown, exposure, trades, costs
comparisons.secondary: M4 minus M2 (same predictions, cadence changed) and M4 minus M3 (same predictions and cost band, cadence changed); M4 minus daily R1 descriptive with the idle-cash caveat
comparisons.block_diagnostic: for each of the 145 matured blocks: teacher label z(i_k, state) vs the realized block return of the executed action (both per share, same path), descriptive only, never fed back

verification: synthetic grid fixtures: decisions only at grid closes, idle cash accumulates and is deployed at the next grid open, hold spans exactly 20 sessions, last pending block executes
cost-band values and sign rule identical to timing-costband-reuse-v1 (reuse its tested functions)
stored-prediction preflight identical to timing-costband-reuse-v1 (hashes, 2400 trees without held splits, 146 traversals for the grid subset)
future-price perturbation leaves grid decisions unchanged; posthoc block diagnostic computed after the ledger

not_in_scope: any threshold, cadence or horizon tuning (20 is the frozen teacher horizon)
a daily-decision policy with a holding lock (asymmetric variant) unless bill prefers it as the single axis instead
expected_outcome_statement: not declared; if cadence matching does not close the gap to always-long, the mismatch hypothesis loses support for this model; if it does, the gain still includes the idle-cash and exposure effects and is not timing skill
